description: Daily step count and energy (joules) from /247 for a datetime range: Name ('stepcount' | 'energyconsumption'), Sources[].Samples[] { TimeISO8601, Value }. The window must be under 28 days (exactly 28 is rejected). Null Value = no data synced. Daily samples are stamped local noon and a one-day window was seen returning that day and the next, so select by the date in TimeISO8601. `from`/`to` are the preferred names of `startdate`/`enddate`.

enddate.description: End datetime, same forms, under 28 days after startdate. Same as `to` (preferred).

from.description: Preferred name of `startdate`; both given and different is an error.

startdate.description: Start datetime ISO 8601, with or without UTC offset (+0200 is rewritten to +02:00, which Suunto requires). Same as `from` (preferred).

to.description: Preferred name of `enddate`; both given and different is an error.

name: get_daily_activity_statistics
title: Get daily activity statistics
